name: Arun Icecreams Bites (Choco & Toffee Flavored Ice Cream)
ingredients_raw: Inner Layer (68%): Ice Cream (Milk Solids, Sugar, Water, Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471, 477), Stabilizers (412, 410), Color (150d) & Nature-Identical Flavoring Substances). Outer Layer (32%): Cocoa Flavored Confectionery (Edible Vegetable Oils (Coconut Oil & Palm Kernel Oil), Sugar, Maltodextrin, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier (322) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances). Allergen Information: Contains Milk. Manufactured in the same facility which processes Wheat, Nuts, Oats & Soy.
